title.zh: GitLab 修复 Ruby 整数溢出远程代码执行漏洞并披露利用尝试
title.en: GitLab Remote Code Execution - Integer Overflow issue

current_state.zh: Alpine Linux披露有人试图利用CVE-2026-97229，这是Ruby正则表达式引擎中的整数溢出远程代码执行漏洞，GitLab仅在其自有软件包中修复，导致源码构建的镜像在10月27日以Ruby 3.3.13重建前一直停留在19.3.6版本并存在漏洞。
current_state.en: Alpine Linux disclosed an attempted exploitation of CVE-2026-97229, an integer-overflow remote code execution flaw in Ruby's regular expression engine that GitLab only patches in its own packages, leaving source-built images on version 19.3.6 vulnerable until the image was rebuilt with Ruby 3.3.13 on October 27.

updates.title_zh: GitLab远程代码执行——整数溢出问题
updates.title_en: GitLab Remote Code Execution - Integer Overflow issue
updates.what_changed_zh: GitLab发布19.5.1补丁，修复一个可能导致远程代码执行的整数溢出漏洞，社区讨论强调其严重性及无需认证的攻击面。
updates.what_changed_en: GitLab released patch 19.5.1 addressing an integer-overflow vulnerability that could enable remote code execution, with community discussion emphasizing its severity and unauthenticated attack surface.
